examples.en: I eat a lot of vegetables.
I washed the vegetables well in water.
I bought onions and carrots at the vegetable shop.

examples.ko: 동생은 채소를 안 좋아해요. 그래서 고기만 먹어요.
examples.en: My younger sibling doesn't like vegetables. So he only eats meat.

explain: 채소와 야채는 같은 뜻이에요. 말할 때는 “야채”도 많이 써요.
